nary_nodes.label: Regional conflict
evidence: Saudi Arabia has spent five months trying not to get dragged into a regional conflict
Now it appears hemmed in, facing enemies in three directions: Iran as well as its proxies in Iraq and Yemen.

nary_nodes.label: Saudi-US strikes in Iraq
evidence: Early Tuesday local time, it became clear restraint was no longer an option –– its fighter jets, along with US planes, carried out strikes across eastern Iraq.

nary_nodes.label: Houthi missile attacks
evidence: In the last week, the kingdom has faced missile attacks from the Iranian-backed Houthis in Yemen
At the weekend the Houthis fired missiles at two Saudi oil complexes on the Red Sea coast.

nary_nodes.label: Drone attacks from Iraq
evidence: drone attacks from pro-Iranian militias in Iraq

Among the palm groves of southern Iraq, pro-Iranian militias launched two barrages of drones targeting critical Saudi infrastructure and the capital Riyadh on Monday and Tuesday, according to the Saudi defense ministry.

nary_nodes.label: Renewed threats from Iran
evidence: renewed threats from Tehran

nary_nodes.label: Saudi-Iran détente
evidence: That in part drove its policy of détente with Iran long before the war, which led to an agreement mediated by China in 2023.

nary_nodes.label: China-mediated agreement
evidence: which led to an agreement mediated by China in 2023.

nary_nodes.label: Houthi blockade
evidence: The missile strikes followed Houthi attacks on two Saudi tankers in the Red Sea after the group announced a blockade of Saudi shipping transiting the Bab al-Mandeb chokepoint.

nary_nodes.label: Houthi tanker attacks
evidence: The missile strikes followed Houthi attacks on two Saudi tankers in the Red Sea
The Houthis claimed a further attack on a Saudi vessel Monday.

nary_nodes.label: Saudi offensive in Yemen
evidence: Saudi Arabia spent seven years trying and failing to dislodge the Houthis from northern Yemen, launching a large-scale offensive against the militant group in 2015.

nary_nodes.label: 2022 truce
evidence: A truce was arranged in 2022, but it never became a peace.

nary_nodes.label: Houthi accusation of bombing
evidence: Earlier this month, the Houthis accused Saudi Arabia of bombing the airport in the capital, Sanaa, to stop a direct flight from Tehran landing after it had ignored warnings to divert.

nary_nodes.label: Tehran-Sanaa flight
evidence: The flight was carrying a Houthi delegation returning from the funeral of Iran’s former Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei.

nary_nodes.label: Saudi strike on Hodeidah
evidence: On Friday, the Saudi air force targeted the port at Hodeidah, the largest under Houthi control, in retaliation for the tanker attacks.

nary_nodes.label: Saudi strikes on Iran
evidence: Saudi Arabia did carry out some air strikes against Iran early in the conflict, but they were carefully calibrated, according to a diplomat familiar with events.

nary_nodes.label: Saudi economic deficit
evidence: In the first three months of this year, it recorded its biggest quarterly deficit since 2018 as it boosted spending to offset the effects of the war and a sluggish economy.

nary_nodes.label: Joint operation response
evidence: US Central Command (CENTCOM) said the joint operation was “a strong response” to over 30 drone attacks that it said had been directed by the Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.

nary_nodes.label: Abqaiq attack
evidence: Saudi officials will not have forgotten the precise and devastating attack on the Abqaiq refinery in 2019, which took out nearly half of Saudi’s oil production.

nary_nodes.label: Investment in anti-drone tech
evidence: In March and April, Saudi authorities scrambled to invest in anti-drone technology as Iranian Shahed drones targeted oil installations on its east coast.

nary_nodes.label: Zelensky visit to Riyadh
evidence: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky visited Riyadh to offer an integrated defensive system to defend against the Iranian drone swarms.

nary_nodes.label: Iranian foreign ministry claim
evidence: its foreign ministry claimed again this week that “some countries of the Persian Gulf independently participated in military attacks on Iran. The US is responsible for the attacks, but the role of some regional countries cannot be ignored.”

evidence: Saudi Arabia did carry out some air strikes against Iran early in the conflict, but they were carefully calibrated, according to a diplomat familiar with events.
